sheet_row_after_update.Topic: Write the handoff note before you log off
sheet_row_after_update.Angle: Common mistake fix: handoffs that only live in one person's head
sheet_row_after_update.Draft:
Most handoffs fail quietly. Nobody notices until the person who knew everything is offline and a client is waiting on an answer.

The fix is small. Before you log off, write three lines somewhere the team can see them: what is finished, what is still open, and where the next person should look first. It does not need a template or a meeting.

A good note names the file, the person, or the link, not the idea. "Check the invoice thread" is useful. "Follow up on billing" sends someone searching.

The part people skip is the second line. Finished work is easy to describe. The open items are the ones that live only in your head, and those are the ones that stall a project when you are not around.

Try it for one week on one project and see whether the questions in your inbox change.

What is the one thing on your current project that only you know right now?

#RemoteWork #Operations #VirtualAssistant #Productivity
